description: The chart, Figure 8, represents the distribution of time costs before and after efficient deployment. The pie chart is divided into two slices. The larger slice, labeled "Reduction" and colored orange, occupies approximately 69.92% of the chart, while the smaller slice, labeled "Efficient deployment" and colored blue, takes up around 30.08%. The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, with "Reduction" corresponding to 60.9 seconds and "Efficient deployment" corresponding to 26.2 seconds. The two slices are visually distinct due to their different colors and percentage labels. The chart does not include a legend, and the slices are not ordered in a particular way beyond their relative sizes.
